race.comment: AMALFI BLUE (4) comes into this as a quickest on the card winner last time at this track, scoring by 1.75 lengths (18.91). Should be in this for a long way. HEY ERNIE (1) boasts a strong record this journey with 10 wins and eight minors from 26 tries. Placed last time (19.15) at this track in a Free For All, finishing second and beaten a nose. Looks suited here and can measure up. NAME OF LOVE (8) clocked a new course and distance PB last time, finishing a 0.8 lengths second behind REDEEMER'S WAY in 19.07. Has the ability and looks a key chance. REDEEMER'S WAY (5) recorded a 0.8 lengths win (19.01) in a Grade 4 last time at this track. Loves this draw, having won three of five starts.
